comment: Vercel Hobby tier registers only the first ~3 cron entries. We had 9 listed; only prices, releases, repress were actually scheduled — the other 6 (warm-releases, daily-digest, weekly-report, this-day, lastfm-sync, lastfm-scrobble-sync) silently never ran. Workaround: /api/cron/prices is now the MASTER cron that fans out to those sub-tasks via internal fetch (see route.js). When upgrading to Pro, restore the original 9-cron config from git history.
